response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS ov FROM joined), pairs AS (SELECT j.transref, j.tradekind, AVG(j.optvolrt) AS avg_ovr, ABS(AVG(j.optvolrt) - o.ov) AS dev FROM joined j CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY j.transref, j.tradekind, o.ov), pd AS (SELECT * FROM pairs WHERE dev IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT p.*, AVG(p.dev) OVER (PARTITION BY p.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM pd p WHERE p.tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_ovr, dev, dev - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE dev > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_ovr) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
